question: For each year, which driver and which constructor scored the most points? I want the full name of each driver.
sql:
-- Final query using drivers_ext for full_name
WITH last_driver_races AS (
    SELECT r.year, MAX(ds.race_id) as last_race_id
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year
),
last_constructor_races AS (
    SELECT r.year, MAX(cs.race_id) as last_race_id
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year
),
driver_final AS (
    SELECT ds.driver_id, ds.points, ldr.year
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN last_driver_races ldr ON ds.race_id = ldr.last_race_id
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ldr.year ORDER BY ds.points DESC) = 1
),
constructor_final AS (
    SELECT cs.constructor_id, cs.points, lcr.year
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN last_constructor_races lcr ON cs.race_id = lcr.last_race_id
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lcr.year ORDER BY cs.points DESC) = 1
)
SELECT df.year,
       de.full_name as driver_full_name,
       ROUND(df.points, 1) as driver_points,
       c.name as constructor_name,
       ROUND(cf.points, 1) as constructor_points
FROM driver_final df
JOIN constructor_final cf ON df.year = cf.year
JOIN drivers_ext de ON df.driver_id = de.driver_id
JOIN constructors c ON cf.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY df.year
